page.overview:
Who is Bottle Top Roaches?

The Bottle Top Roaches are minor characters in A Bug's Life.

"Roaches love the night life. Sunshine isn't their thing at all, so they hang out at their bottle top table until the sun goes down. Tonight, when the bar starts rocking, they will be leaving early."
